The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core logic for risk assessment.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.80 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest results confirm 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed in 0.29 seconds using pytest version 8.4.1. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the weighting algorithm to ensure the 0.80 judge reward can be improved to parity with the verifier.
